children: First American Financial raised its quarterly cash dividend to 61 cents a share from 55 cents.
The increased dividend is payable on Oct. 5 to shareholders of record as of Sept. 28.
The new payout, equal to $2.44 a year, represents an annual yield of 3.4% based on Wednesday's closing price of $71.11.
